page.layout: One column of verse, with stanza numbers 6 to 18 at the left edge of each stanza. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: 6. Prostratos relevat, qui ad fudū[?] deprimit altos,
Deiectos tollit, rixosos trudit ad Orcum.
7. Voce igitur fidibúsque Dei mirada canamus.
Dicamus, veluti fluitantia nubila cælo
8. Suspendat, madido sensim densata vapore,
Unde imbres stillēt[?] tribuit qui collibus herba.
9. Gramina qui pecori, pullis dat hiantibus esca,
Coruorū donec nigrescat candida pluma.
10. Pernici nō gaudet equo, aut cervice torosa,
Aut humeris hominum latis furave rotunda:
11. Sed gaudet Domin[?] tremulis ad pectora palmis,
Inflexis genubus, fletūq; per ora cadente.
12. Tu quoq; sacra Sion, Solyma, laudate Tonate.
Est custos urbis, vectesq; affigit ahenos
13. Liminibus pulchris: præcingit[?] turribus urbem.
Ipse suos redimat cives, & pace beata
14. Vallabit regnum, similia[?] nos pascit abunde,
Qui sibi cursores laxat spiramina cæli
15. Æolidas ventos, quos tanquam in follibus
arctat.
Flante Aquilone nivis floccos & vellera spargit,
16. Seu cinere offuscat nebulis humentibus auras,
Instar crystalli glacies ut vitrea pendet,
17. Stiria de tectis velut unio caulibus haeret,
Horrida fauit hyēs[?], fit marmore durior unda.
18. E regione Deus tepidis Nothon enocat alis,
Soluuntur latices[?], liquefactāq; flumina currunt.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Possible printed abbreviations (tilde/macron marks over u, o, e) read as best as possible; "fudū", "Domin", "hyēs", "stillēt" and "furave" are doubtful. "similia", "præcingit", "latices" and "Solyma" are read from a small, faint scan and should be checked. The superscript after "Domin" is not reproduced. Stanza 15 includes the continuation line "Flante Aquilone... spargit," which is in the same stanza.
